summary: The Admin sidebar's Specs & docs group carries `UI Specs v2`, a row that opens the v2 draft pages in a new tab — moved out of the Project Spec submenu, where it was the departing `Docs — draft pages` link. The row points at a new internal door (`/admin/spec/ui-v2`) that gates like its spec siblings and redirects to the drafts' own deployment, so no external href enters the rail's document; nav document v6 adds `leaving` so the click is drawn through `LeavingLink` instead of teleporting the reader off-site.
reader_impact: An admin reading the rail finds `UI Specs v2` under Specs & docs and one click opens the draft docs in a new tab, marked as leaving; the Project Spec submenu no longer carries a Docs row and no longer has a second door to the same pages.
